blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Cultural agencies on Thursday raised concerns about the possible overlap with existing historical facilities as the Senate deliberates on a proposal to establish a museum dedicated to revolutionary leader Andres Bonifacio. During the Senate committee on culture and the arts hearing, representatives of the National Historical Commission of the Philippines (NHCP) urged lawmakers to carefully assess the need for a separate institution.
